Crops in the wrong conditions just stop growing. A Frostberry field near a snow block, or an Emberpepper field next to a lava pool, works anywhere in the world.

A planter is a box of soil that grows its crop on a timer, wherever you put it and whatever the light, biome or water. When it is ripe, right-click or hit it to harvest 1 to 2 of the crop (times your Farming Fortune), with Dew and rare-find rolls. It then starts growing again. Sneak and hit it with an empty hand to pick it up. Place planters anywhere outside the hub.

s.x: The Planter Tender talent shortens regrowth by 6% per rank (never by more than half).
A sprinkler waters every crop in a square around it every 5 seconds: the crops get extra growth and the farmland under them stays wet, so a sprinkler field needs no water. That makes crops grow about
than on their own. The extra growth follows the server's crop growth speed (the

game rule), so it stays 14 times faster however fast the server sets crops to grow. Sprinklers boost wheat-type crops, the special crops, and melon and pumpkin stems, but not sugar cane, cactus, cocoa or nether wart. Special crops still need their condition. Bigger sprinklers reach further (a 5x5, 7x7 or 9x9 square, and one level up and down), and each is made from the one before.

Meals are cooked at the Artisan Bench (the Cooking tab). Eating one gives a 10-minute boost, and a new meal replaces the last one.
